title: Sequin Knit Long Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine bright in this stunning Sequin Knit Fitted Sleeve Evening Dress! Featuring a curve-hugging silhouette, shimmering sequins, and elegant fitted sleeves, this dress is perfect for making a glamorous statement at any formal event or special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
